transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer support. My name is Liam. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. My TV set-top box has completely stopped working. It's stuck in some endless boot loop showing error code CS-104 and the kids can't watch anything.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand how frustrating it is when the TV box won't boot up and the family can't watch their shows. Let's look into what's happening.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. The box is connected with the original pink high-speed HDMI cable to an LG OLED television in our living room.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we troubleshoot, I need to verify the account details. Could you state your full address and postcode?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 52 Orchard Way, Bath, BA1 5ND.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And your four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. So what I am hearing is that your TV box is stuck in a boot loop showing error CS-104 on the front panel and won't reach the home menu, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly right. It displays the S-Net welcome screen for ten seconds, flashes CS-104, goes black, and then restarts again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What color is the power LED light on the bottom edge of the box when it cycles?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It turns red first, then flashes amber three times, and then goes back to red.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you tried unplugging the power lead from the mains wall socket at all?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I left it unplugged for about five minutes earlier, but when I plugged it back in, the exact same cycle started up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hold on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Are you still there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I'm here. I was checking the hardware diagnostic manual for error CS-104.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, okay. What does CS-104 indicate?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Error CS-104 indicates that the internal eMMC flash memory cannot load the primary bootloader partition.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does that mean the box is broken?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There is a manual recovery procedure that forces a secondary firmware download from the network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, how do we try that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: On the front of the box, locate the standby power button. Unplug the black power cord from the rear.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Unplugged.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now press and hold that front standby button down with your finger, and while holding it down, plug the power cord back in.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding it down... plugging the lead back in now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Keep holding that button down for twenty seconds until the power light flashes purple.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Still holding... okay, it's flashing purple now. I've let go.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What does your television screen display now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says 'Downloading Software Recovery Package 1 of 3'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's give it three minutes to see if the partition rewrites properly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It reached 14 percent... wait, it just went black again and the red light is back.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Now it's flashing amber three times and CS-104 is back on the screen.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us try switching the HDMI port on your TV just in case HDCP handshake failure is forcing a panic reboot.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I can try that. Unplugging from HDMI 1 and plugging into HDMI 2 now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does the screen change at all on HDMI 2?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, it still says CS-104 on the box display and the screen just shows the same black loop.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms the flash storage sectors have suffered hardware degradation and cannot accept new bootloader data.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So we definitely need a replacement box then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am looking at our warehouse dispatch system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you hear me? Are you checking the delivery dates?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I am checking courier availability for a replacement 4K TV box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long will a replacement take to arrive?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A courier can deliver a new S-Net Ultra 4K box on Thursday between 8 AM and 1 PM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thursday? That's two days away. Is there any way to get it tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously next-day morning slots are already cut off past 2 PM, so Thursday is the earliest our logistics team can guarantee.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, Thursday morning will have to do. What do I do with the broken box?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new box will arrive in a prepaid return carton. Place the faulty unit and power lead inside, seal it, and hand it to the courier or drop it at any Post Office.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I need to return the HDMI cable as well?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, keep your HDMI cable. And what television brand do you have that box connected to?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Like I told you at the start of the call, it's connected to an LG OLED television.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, noted. The new box will configure HDMI-CEC automatically when you plug it into your LG television.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will my existing recordings be saved on the cloud, or are they lost?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Personal recordings on that box were stored on the internal hard drive, so those cannot be recovered, but any On-Demand watchlist items are saved to your S-Net profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's a shame about the recorded films, but I suppose there's no choice if the box failed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Cloud recording is only available on our newer Stream puck devices, not on the hard-drive based 4K boxes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I switch to the Stream puck instead?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A switch to Stream would require a contract change and re-contracting for twenty-four months, whereas a like-for-like replacement box keeps your existing contract terms untouched.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, I definitely don't want to re-contract right now. The like-for-like replacement is fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well if you had actually checked the cables before calling us you wouldn't have wasted twenty minutes of our time when the hardware was dead anyway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Excuse me? I had no idea what error CS-104 meant until I rang you! That's what technical support is for!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have booked the courier delivery for Thursday. Your RMA tracking code is RMA-77412-BA.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine. Can I still use the S-Net TV Go app on my iPad to watch shows in the meantime?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, your live TV subscription remains fully active on mobile devices and laptops via the TV Go app.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: At least the kids can watch cartoons on the tablet until the replacement arrives.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can register up to six devices on the app, with two concurrent streams allowed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can my daughter watch on her laptop in her bedroom while the iPad is playing?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, two streams can play simultaneously across different devices on your home Wi-Fi network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. That will keep the peace in the house for the next two days.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can log into the TV Go website using your primary S-Net email address and account password.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I need to sign for the courier parcel on Thursday, or can they leave it in our safe place by the porch?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A signature is required for set-top box delivery. If no one is home, the courier will leave a calling card for local Royal Mail depot collection.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I work from home on Thursdays, so I will be in all morning to sign for it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will receive an SMS text on Thursday morning with a one-hour delivery time window.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, that's clear. Is there anything else I need to prepare?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just pack the old box and power lead into the return box when the new one arrives.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your S-Net services today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer support. Thank you for choosing S-Net and have a good day.
